title: Try a new equation
prompt: I worked out that 2x = 10 gives x = 5. Give me one different equation so you can see whether I can do it on my own.

title: Predict a coin flip
prompt: A fair coin just landed heads four times. I think tails must be due. Let me make a prediction about the next flip before you explain.

title: Recall three French colours
prompt: I've studied the French words for red, blue and green. See which ones I can recall, one at a time. Don't give me the translations yet.

title: Change a rectangle
prompt: I keep mixing up area and perimeter. Could I change the width of a rectangle while its height stays at 4 and watch what happens to both numbers?

title: Connect a food web
prompt: Grass, grasshoppers, frogs, and herons are in the same food web. I'd like to arrange their connections and see which way the energy flows.

title: Repair an off-by-one loop
prompt: My Python loop skips the last item nearly every time. Give me a tiny broken loop I can fix and try against a couple of example inputs.

title: Choose a practice path
prompt: I want to practice either estimating a shopping total or comparing unit prices. Let me choose the path before we start.

title: Put the steps in order
prompt: I know the steps for making a bar chart but I mix up the sequence. Give me the steps scrambled so I can put them back in order.

title: Answer a bounded fact
prompt: What is 4 factorial? Just give me the value, please.

title: Explain in one sentence
prompt: In one plain sentence, what does the denominator of a fraction tell me? No follow-up exercise, please.
